'''Skeletons''' can be found guarding [[Catolax]]'s tomb during [[Smoking Kills]]. They are situated behind a chasm, and as such attack with long-ranged attacks, those on the ranged path using [[Ranged]], and those on the magic path using [[Magic]].

While they are not required to be defeated, they attack you while you attempt to mine through the doors on their respective paths, and as such can be seen as a nuisance.
